description: Capture a screenshot of a desktop capsule. Returns the image so you can see the screen. For a smaller, faster image ask for format 'jpeg', a scale such as 0.5, or only a region (x, y, w, h) of the screen; the text after the image says how its points map back to screen pixels, which click and the other tools take.

scale.description: Shrink the image to this fraction of the screen, 0.1 to 1

x.description: Region: left edge, in screen pixels

name: capsulate_screenshot
title: Take a screenshot
